# env-sync

Required env vars in misc/env.ts missing from .env.example, compose app env or tests/setup.ts.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--env` | path | no | `misc/env.ts` | File declaring REQUIRED_ENV |
| `--dotenv` | path | no | `.env.example` | Example env file; keys above its '# Optional' heading count |
| `--compose` | path | no | `docker-compose.yml` | Compose file whose app service environment counts |
| `--setup` | path | no | `tests/setup.ts` | Test setup declaring TEST_ENV_DEFAULTS |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run env-sync
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys ok, required, missing.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/env-sync.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
